Chapter Two

The Turning Point

"Everything changed when I stopped chasing leads and started attracting them."

Meet Sarah Chen, a cyber insurance broker from Miami. Three years ago, she was ready to quit. Today, she runs a $5M agency with a team of twelve. What changed?

"I realized I was doing marketing backwards," Sarah tells us. "I was shouting into the void instead of listening to what businesses actually needed."

That's when she discovered the power of data-driven marketing. Instead of guessing, she started knowing. Instead of hoping, she started tracking. Instead of spending, she started investing.
